description: Retrieve one npm / public packages catalog entry by its id, e.g. spl-pay-per-suite, slid-phi, pulsar. Read-only; returns the entry's name, price, notes, and links. Use when you know the exact entry id; use npm_search to find an id by keyword. An unknown id returns an error listing the known ids.

id.description: Entry id within the npm / public packages catalog, e.g. spl-pay-per-suite, slid-phi, pulsar. Get the id list from npm_search with an empty query; an unknown id returns an error listing the known ids.

name: npm_get
